gaps.explanation: Re-read pp5-13, 32-36. Statement p6 (GAAP) Total revenues 844,085,039 = General 478,288,466 + Debt Service 68,917,482 + Grants 148,695,200 + Street and Highway Allocation 89,115,207 + Nonmajor Governmental Funds 59,068,684. Detail 818,342,611: Debt Service, Street and Highway Allocation and Grants tie exactly. (1) General Fund: p6 GAAP 478,288,466 vs the budgetary-basis schedule p12 Actual Total revenues 467,383,118 = 10,905,348 (two printed bases). (2) Nonmajor column 59,068,684 vs the 15 nonmajor budget schedules in detail 44,231,604 = 14,837,080: nonmajor funds without a schedule in the trim (no combining nonmajor statements in pp1-36; the trim goes from RSI/budget schedules to statistical schedules pp34-36). Adding the Nonmajor column would double count the 15 schedules, and the missing funds' share is only a remainder (derived). 10,905,348 + 14,837,080 = 25,742,428 = gap. Unfixable from printed amounts.

Statement p6 Total expenditures 925,567,803 = General 480,429,809 + Debt Service 80,443,919 + Grants 157,052,816 + Street and Highway Allocation 73,413,101 + Nonmajor 134,228,158. Detail 814,204,000. (1) General: p6 480,429,809 vs budgetary p13 Total expenditures 469,036,765 = 11,393,044 (two printed bases). (2) Nonmajor 134,228,158 vs 15 nonmajor schedules in detail 34,257,399 = 99,970,759, funds whose combining statements are not in the trim (page not in trim; remainder only). 11,393,044 + 99,970,759 = 111,363,803 = gap.

Statement p6 Transfers in 28,662,732 = General 7,972,393 + Grants 3,039,180 + Street and Highway Allocation 17,592 + Nonmajor 17,633,567. Detail 5,289,324 = Grants 3,039,180 (p6) + Street 17,592 (p14) + Ballpark Revenue 965,818 (p26) + Destination Marketing Corporation 1,266,734 (p29). (1) General 7,972,393: the General Fund's own schedule is the budgetary-basis schedule pp12-13, which prints 'Transfers in -' and no transfer rows; its revenue/expenditure lines are on another basis (e.g. 'Other funds' 10,963,354), so whether the interfund money is inside them cannot be read from the page; not added (could double count). (2) Nonmajor 17,633,567 - 2,232,552 in detail = 15,401,015 belongs to nonmajor funds with no schedule in the trim (remainder; page not in trim). 7,972,393 + 15,401,015 = 23,373,408 = gap.

Statement p6 Transfers out (23,345,045) = General (17,593,896) + Grants (956,315) + Street and Highway Allocation (100,000) + Nonmajor (4,694,834). Detail 4,911,775 = Grants 956,315 (p6) + Street 100,000 (p14) + City Street Maintenance 17,592 (p22) + Interceptor Sewer Construction 2,571,134 (p23) + GOCVB 1,266,734 (p28). (1) General 17,593,896: not printed on the budgetary-basis schedule pp12-13 (no transfer rows; budgetary 'Other funds' 10,963,354 is an expenditure line that may hold interfund amounts); not added. (2) Nonmajor 4,694,834 - 3,855,460 in detail = 839,374 in nonmajor funds with no schedule in the trim (remainder). 17,593,896 + 839,374 = 18,433,270 = gap.

Statement p6 'Issuance of debt' 111,006,060 is printed only in the Nonmajor Governmental Funds column. JSON debt_proceeds 111,006,060 + other_financing 40,265,481 (Lease 41,806,379 + Premium on debt issued 14,316,868 + Proceeds on sale of capital assets 8,618,459 - Payment to escrow agent 24,476,225) = 151,271,541. Detail non-transfer other-financing lines: Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax Fund (p33) Issuance of refunding debt 20,866,060, Premium on debt issued 3,902,098, Payment to escrow agent (24,476,225); Debt Service Fund (p32) Premium on debt issued 554,770; General Fund Lease 41,806,379 (p6); Nonmajor Governmental Funds Proceeds on sale of capital assets 8,618,459 (p6) = 51,271,541. Remaining 100,000,000 = Nonmajor issuance 111,006,060 - 20,866,060 = 90,140,000 plus Nonmajor premium 13,762,098 - 3,902,098 = 9,860,000, both belonging to nonmajor (capital projects) funds whose combining statements/schedules are not in the trimmed PDF (pp1-36). Adding the Nonmajor column amounts would double count the Riverfront lines, and the remainders are derived; not added. All other p6 other-financing rows are in detail; no mislabelled transfer lines.
